changeSet.author: paypulse
changeSet.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto

changeSet.author: paypulse
changeSet.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS payment_command

changeSet.author: paypulse
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE payment_command.event_store ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, aggregate_id UUID NOT NULL, aggregate_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, event_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL, payload JSONB NOT NULL, occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT (timezone('utc', now())), CONSTRAINT uk_event_store_aggregate_version UNIQUE (aggregate_id, version) )
ALTER TABLE payment_command.event_store REPLICA IDENTITY FULL

changeSet.author: paypulse
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE payment_command.outbox ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, partitioning_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, payload JSONB NOT NULL, idempotency_key UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT (timezone('utc', now())), processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ(3) NULL )
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_outbox_idempotency_key ON payment_command.outbox (idempotency_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_outbox_status_created ON payment_command.outbox (status, created_at)

changeSet.author: paypulse
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE payment_command.idempotency_keys ( key_hash VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, response_body JSONB NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT (timezone('utc', now())), expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ(3) NOT NULL )

changeSet.author: paypulse
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE payment_command.event_store ALTER COLUMN payload TYPE TEXT USING payload::text

changeSet.author: paypulse
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE payment_command.idempotency_keys ALTER COLUMN response_body TYPE TEXT USING response_body::text
